rows.text: The Month of Gate marks the beginning of a year. During this month, people discard possessions they no longer need, burn items connected to those they were bonded with, declaring a break from the past and facing the future head-on.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: In the previous Month of Mourning, war devoured your dearest friend. The soldiers brought back his body atop their shields, and Thanatos has taken him into their palm. People recommend you attend this year's Enkindle Ceremony. It's time for you to begin a new life.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "May Thanatos be kind to my mother." The stern-faced man tosses a clay bowl into the fire pit, then walks over and pats your shoulder. It's your turn.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
